study: future motion and task-irrelevant visible background appearance
background: Symmetric tint on visible, segmented floor, walls or static backdrop meshes in each room. Both colour variants share identical physics and the untinted anchor.
margin_basis: Proposed engineering limit of 5 mm full path RMS for a pre-contact reach. Choose before held-out outcomes. This is at most one quarter of the minimum 20 mm per-side depicted displacement; it is not a contact tolerance or a perceptual threshold.
probe: Per task, fit normalized direction templates to paired feature differences on unique development starts, then orient blinded held-out pairs. Pool seeds within start. At least 75% correctly oriented, one-sided binomial p<.05 vs random signs per property across tasks; positive majority per task. Report shuffled-label control, per-task errors and scores.
primary_motion: World-x signed half-difference after 32 controls with neutral appearance; equal task weights, paired seeds averaged per start, task-stratified state bootstrap 95% CI.
primary_background: Within each side compare warm/cool against neutral, calculate full 3D path RMS after 32 controls, take max across four contrasts per seed, then average seeds by state. One-sided upper 95% bound <5 mm for bounded mean; lower bound >5 mm for nuisance sensitivity.
positive_motion: 95% lower bound above zero and positive mean in every claimed task. For broad family claims require supporting checkpoints and environments separately.
selectivity: Mean within-start signed motion half-difference minus absolute projected warm-cool endpoint half-difference averaged over motion sides.
sample_size: Plan 80% power for 4 mm motion with pooled within-task SD (minimum planning SD 8 mm); separately use calibration for a one-sided background bound; allow for complete-pair eligibility. Minimum 12 fresh attempts/task, maximum 16 given unused book starts. Also report when margin cannot be resolved.
alternatives: Flag inconclusive where coverage, test precision, or the property manipulation fails. Show all measured data; do not replace an unsuccessful control.
secondary: 10-control prefix, developing-camera stabilized wrist, Long-WAM's own source on development starts, raw same-scale magnitude and run timing.
scope: Explicit LIBERO clips in FastWAM Optional IDM and Long-WAM IDM. Separate RoboTwin Long-WAM release after native validation. Other three backends remain a distinct native feature experiment.
